## 1. Global Enhancement Strategy & 11-Section Template Standard

Every page below will be expanded from its current word count to **1,800+ words** by incorporating the standardized 11-section architectural framework:
1. **Hero Header & Instant Lead Form** (Localized H1, Call/WhatsApp CTAs)
2. **Trust & Feature Badge Bar** (100% Safe, IBA Approved, GPS Tracked, 2,500+ Moves)
3. **Comprehensive Route & Locality Overview** (Detailed highway/transit corridors)
4. **Itemized Tariff & Cost Breakdown Table** (1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK, Bike, Car rates)
5. **5-Stage Damage-Free Relocation Workflow** (Survey, Packing, Loading, Transit, Unboxing)
6. **IBA Approved Billing & Claim Guidance** (Genuine GST invoices, insurance claim support)
7. **Custom Packaging Materials & Crating Breakdown** (7-layer bubble wrap, foam, wooden crates)
8. **Vehicle & Car Carrier Transport Logistics** (Hydraulic ramp trailers, wheel-chocks)
9. **Related Locality & Intercity Link Cards Matrix** (Internal linking grid)
10. **20 Localized Frequently Asked Questions** (Schema JSON-LD populated)
11. **Bottom Call-to-Action Banner & Lead Capture**
